correction: SetAppID's comment said MyGo leaves GLib's program name to the executable's name, so naming it before mygo.App.Run was enough. MyGo v0.9.0 calls g_set_prgname with the executable's name in App.Run (egoist/mygo#1640), after SetAppID, and GLib keeps the last name: every window's Wayland app ID was the executable's name (ChairLift's was "chairlift", not org.frostyard.ChairLift), so GNOME showed a generic icon. SetAppID now names the program again from mygo.App.WhenReady
evidence: WAYLAND_DEBUG=client of chairlift v0.17.0 (frostui v0.5.1, MyGo v0.9.0) --first-run --dry-run: xdg_toplevel.set_app_id("chairlift"); with this change: set_app_id("org.frostyard.ChairLift.FirstRun"); MyGo v0.9.0 internal/linux/app.go:124-125
